Cates Bay Crossing offers five one- and two-story floor plans priced from the $260s. Select plans feature versatile living spaces such as flex rooms, gamerooms, and private studies.
Move-In Ready Options:
Cates Bay Crossing features a mix of move-in ready homes and winter move-in homes, for buyers seeking a faster new construction timeline.

CONWAY, S.C., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (

)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—will host a model home Grand Opening at Cates Bay Crossing, a Century Complete community in Conway, South Carolina, offering new homes from the $260s.

The event will take place on Saturday, Nov. 21, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. Visitors can tour the new model home and meet members of The Myrtle Beach Pelicans, the local Minor League Baseball team, who will be in attendance from noon to 2 p.m.
Learn more and RSVP for the Grand Opening at

"Cates Bay Crossing pairs adaptable, attainably priced new homes with a scenic location that's a short drive from schools with easy access to Myrtle Beach," said Regional President Andy Kern. "Prospective homebuyers should attend our Nov. 21 Grand Opening to explore move-in ready options, tour our new model, and find out what makes this the perfect place for their next chapter."

Cates Bay Crossing's location makes it an attractive choice for a new home, with Myrtle Beach about 15 miles from the community—putting natural beauty, outdoor recreational opportunities, and waterfront attractions in easy reach.

Downtown Conway's Riverwalk, shops and dining are nearby, and Pee Dee Elementary School, Whittemore Park Middle School, and Conway High School are each less than eight miles away. Nicknamed the "Golf Capital of the World," Myrtle Beach also features dozens of golf courses for residents to enjoy.

Cates Bay Crossing offers modern one- and two-story floor plans showcasing spacious layouts and open kitchens, with up to 5 bedrooms, 3 baths, and 2,653 square feet. Homebuyers seeking space for growing households will find versatile living spaces—including flex rooms, studies, gamerooms, and lofts—that can be adapted to fit current and future needs.
Designer-selected standard features include quartz countertops, white Shaker-style cabinets, LG® stainless-steel kitchen appliances, luxury vinyl plank flooring, and Kohler® fixtures.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Question:
When is the Cates Bay Crossing model home Grand Opening in Conway, South Carolina?
Answer:

The Cates Bay Crossing model home Grand Opening in Conway, South Carolina is Saturday, Nov. 21, 2026, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. Special guests from the Myrtle Beach Pelicans will be present from noon to 2 p.m.
Question:
How much do homes at Cates Bay Crossing in Conway, South Carolina cost?
Answer:
Single-family homes at Cates Bay Crossing in Conway, South Carolina start from the $260s. The community offers five floor plans of 1,773 to 2,653 square feet.
Question:
What floor plans are available at Cates Bay Crossing in Conway, South Carolina?
Answer:
Cates Bay Crossing offers five floor plans—Roanoke, Essex, Amelia, Gardner and Granby—ranging from 1,773 to 2,653 square feet. Roanoke is one story, and the other four plans are two stories.
Question:
What is included in Cates Bay Crossing homes in Conway, South Carolina?

Every Cates Bay Crossing home in Conway, South Carolina includes quartz countertops, LG® stainless-steel appliances, Kohler® fixtures, and more.
Question:
How far is Cates Bay Crossing in Conway, South Carolina from Myrtle Beach?
Answer:
Cates Bay Crossing in Conway, South Carolina is about 15 miles from Myrtle Beach and offers new construction homes from the $260s.
Question:
What are the sales office hours at Cates Bay Crossing in Conway, South Carolina?
Answer:
The Cates Bay Crossing sales office in Conway, South Carolina is open Monday–Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., and Sunday, noon to 6 p.m.
